players.product: medium-voltage switchgear, power control rooms / electrical houses and Remsdaq automation controllers for data-center utility connection (38 kV) and behind-the-meter on-site generation power islands

quarterly_data.signal: Powell's 10-Q states that in the electric utility market it secured total bookings of $313 million during the first nine months of fiscal 2026, reflecting continued customer investment in grid modernization, transmission and distribution infrastructure and generation capacity expansion. For the nine months ended June 30, 2026, commercial and other industrial revenue increased 28% to $171.4 million and electric utility revenue increased 21% to $238.4 million.
quarterly_data.figure: electric utility bookings $313 million (first nine months of fiscal 2026); nine months ended June 30, 2026: commercial and other industrial revenue $171.4 million (+28%), electric utility revenue $238.4 million (+21%)
